records.title: Cooperative National Geologic Map — Earth surface

rights.text: The official version 2 ArcGIS item states public domain and requests source citation. Retain MapSourceID/DataSources provenance; private capture does not establish source admission, review, display readiness or release.

records.description: Interpreted earth surface product in the Cooperative National Geologic Map. Initial publication 2025; version 2 released September 3, 2026. The offered GeMS ZIP is a full national archive, not a Kansas-only subset. The exact download returned verified-TLS HTTP 200 and Content-Length on October 8, 2026; only response headers were read. HEAD attempts timed out and archive contents are uninspected. The separate map-unit service supports bounded source previews. These thematic interpretations are not a continuous three-dimensional geology model; retain MapSourceID and linked DataSources citations and source-specific mapping limitations.
